title: metrosideros waialealae var. fauriei
intro: Metrosideros waialealae var. fauriei, commonly known as the red flower haw, is a plant species native to Hawaii. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties and is known to have health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects, which can help to alleviate symptoms of various health conditions. The therapeutic actions of Metrosideros waialealae var. fauriei include wound healing, antimicrobial, and anti-inflammatory properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other compounds that contribute to its medicinal properties.
